site.title: Sign up for an Atmosphere account

embed.genericDescription: Try sign-in forms and host pickers. Change the layout, styling, language, and account hosts.
embed.appDescription: Start with an Atmosphere account. Choose your provider and use your account across compatible apps.

intro.title: Your account on the Atmosphere
intro.generic: The Atmosphere is an open network of apps and independent account hosts. One account can work across compatible apps.
intro.app: {{appName}} is part of the Atmosphere, an open network of apps and independent account hosts. One account can work across compatible apps.
intro.network: Sign in with your existing Atmosphere account, wherever it is hosted.
intro.hosting: Your host stores your account and app data. Create your account on its website.
intro.reuse: Use the same handle in compatible apps. Each app asks for the access it needs.
intro.ownership: You can move your account to another host. Migration tools and app support vary.

providers.title: Choose an account host
providers.intro: Your host stores your account and data. Check its terms, region, and signup requirements before continuing to its website.
providers.empty: This app has no account hosts available for signup.
providers.regionHint: Leave all unchecked to show every region. Listed regions do not guarantee data residency.
providers.noMatchesHint: Try another region or clear your filters.
providers.customHint: Enter the HTTPS address of a host that is not listed.

complete.title: Your Atmosphere account is ready
complete.handleHint: Use this handle to sign in to compatible apps.
complete.handleUnavailable: Your account is ready, but we couldn’t verify your handle right now. You can find it in your provider’s account settings.
complete.app: Sign in to {{appName}} with your new account.

errors.title: We could not complete this step
errors.unknownApp: That app is not registered. You can still create an account, but we won’t redirect you afterward.
errors.initialization: The sign-in client could not start. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unsupportedProvider: This host’s sign-in service is unavailable or unsupported. Try again or choose another host.
errors.authorization: We could not open your account host. Check your connection and try again.
errors.cancelled: Sign-in cancelled. Try again when you’re ready.
errors.callback: We could not verify the sign-in result. Start again to reconnect.
errors.providers: The host list is unavailable. Try again.
errors.redirect: This app’s return URL is invalid. Your account is ready, but we won’t redirect you.
errors.cleanup: Your account is ready, but we couldn’t confirm launcher credential cleanup. You can revoke the launcher’s access in your provider’s settings.
errors.identifier: Enter your full handle, such as alice.example.com, or an AT Protocol DID.
errors.service: Enter an HTTPS host address without a username, password, query, or fragment.
errors.provider: This account host is not available for signup in this app. Choose another host.

signin.title: Sign in to {{appName}}
signin.label: Your handle
signin.hint: Enter your full handle, such as alice.example.com.
signin.explain: Sign in on your account host’s website and review the access this app requests.

demo.title: Launcher Components · Atmosphere login
demo.heading: Login components for the Atmosphere
demo.hostPolicy: Limiting signup hosts disables custom addresses. Existing accounts can still use any host.
demo.copyFailed: Select and copy the code below
demo.en.handleHint: Handle searches go to Bluesky as you type. You can also enter a full handle or DID.
demo.es.handleHint: Enviamos tus búsquedas a Bluesky mientras escribes. También puedes introducir un identificador completo o un DID.
demo.es.complete: Inicio de sesión de prueba completado
demo.en.result: No account was created or connected.
demo.es.result: No se creó ni se conectó ninguna cuenta.
demo.pickerIntro: Select a host to see its URL.
demo.transportHint: The code uses the OAuth adapter with your app’s client.
